Single-seed dev screening; paired task-stratified 95% intervals are descriptive. Selection uses these same dev outcomes; intervals do not account for selection or trained-seed uncertainty. Point-estimate gates are inclusive; C* near-best rule is strictly <1 pp. T0 is S1 only; no same-depth T0 or parameter-efficiency claim.

Intervention differences, read diagnostics, learning curves, parameter/state/operation counts, raw latency and measured cost provenance are retained in analysis.json.
